dependencies.interpretation: The HKMA Base Rate is formula-linked to the lower bound of the prevailing U.S. federal funds target range and HIBOR inputs. A FOMC clock is therefore an HKD readiness dependency, not an independent HKMA decision or a guaranteed HKD direction.

Danish monetary policy maintains the krone's central rate against the euro. An ECB decision is therefore a DKK readiness dependency, but Danmarks Nationalbank need not change an official rate at the same time or by the same amount.

explicit_non_dependencies.reason: MAS conducts monetary policy through the exchange-rate band and publishes statements twice yearly; no exact October 2026 release clock has been verified, so no foreign meeting is substituted as its decision clock.
